verdict.rationale: No option clearly dominates under ordinary travel reasoning. A is cheapest and arrives relatively early but has two connections. B has only one connection and a very large buffer, but arrives much later and costs more. C is the earliest one-stop arrival and is less expensive than D, but its 49-minute IAD connection is comparatively risky. D offers a more comfortable one-stop connection but at the highest price. Selecting among cost, number of stops, connection-risk tolerance, and preferred arrival time requires unstated preferences.
